book.name: 2 TIMOTEO
book.title: 2 TIMOTEO Timoteo qui Pablonen raanni joi, jahuen rabe sca

content: Jesucriston sontaro siri
Mia rihbi Jesucriston shinanya jihuehahnan coshiscahue, heen baquen.
Hichaxon nincanon bi hen mia haxemani joibo shinanyahpa jonibo haxemaribihue, jaabaan sca caibo rihbi haxemanon hihxon.
Jesucriston siri sontaroxon yobaxon sca tenehue.
Sontarohax tah non noque sontarohihmahiton yohihi quescabijaquin hahnoxon tsoabi non huetsa tee janin cayamascai.
Jaton coshi tanacatsihquibaan rihbi ta bishquihihti hihbaan yohihi quescabihi bishquihihyamaxon jahuabi bihtimahiqui.
Teemis huaijanicahten pari ta jahuen huai bimihi bihtihiqui.
Hen mia yohihi joibo sirijaquin shinanhue. Noquen Hihbaan ta mia jatihibi sirijaquin honanmatihiqui.
Jesucristo shinanbehnoyamahue. Jahuen joi siri yohiquin hen chanicoinai quescabihi ta jaa mahuatipish bi huenirihbinishqui. David ta jahuen papa xeni japahonishqui.
Jaa joi siri hen yohicoinni copi tah hen sipo xoboho tsahotai, tiroma joni sipo xoboho tsahona quesca. Hea jascajahibaan bi ta Papan joi pantehahma caichihqui.
Jaa copi tah hen jatihibi tenehi, Papan caisaibo nincamanoxon hihxon. Jaabaan rihbi Jesucristo bihcoinax queyoyamanox mananon hihxon tah hen tenehi, jahuen queyoyosma xabapan jihuetahbo hihxon.

content.text: Hihcointi ta nea yohuanbo qui. Hahbetanbi mahuatax tah non hahbetanbi rihbi sca jihueyaxihqui.
Tiromajahahbaan bi tenexon tah non hahbetan rihbi jonibo jihuemayaxihqui. Jaa ta heen jahuama qui hih non jaiya ta jaa rihbi noque qui jascarihbiyaxihquiqui, jaabo ta heen jahuamabo qui, hihqui.
Jan yohihi quescabija non jayamahi bi ta jaan hahquiqui, jan yohihi quescabijaquin. Jahuen joi yohihi ta Henama ta qui, jaa jatimahiqui.

content: Hahcoinai teexonnicah

Jascapa joibo jato yohihue, shinanbehnoyamahahbo. Noquen Hihbaan jisnon bi tah hen mato yohihi hihxon jato yohihue, yohuanaibo joi bichinnannanyamahahbo. Join bahchinnannanxon tah non nincacaibo shinan hinanyamahi. Jato tiromajaresquin.
Siri teexonnica mia Papan jisnon hihxon min hahtipahi tihi hahhue, jahua copi hihtimahti yamanon. Jato pontequin jahuen joi jato honanmacoinhue.
Papan rahninai yohuanbo nincayamahue. Jascapa yohuanbo nincacax ta hashoan sca Papan shinanjomabo jaticaniqui.
Shomon hanihihcamahi ta jaton yohuan caitihiqui. Jascapa yohuanya rabe ta Himeneo betan Fileto qui.
Papan joi coin jenebahinax ta yohuancaniqui: mahuataibo ta Papan hueniscahoxqui, hihqui. Jascapahbo yohuanquin ta caibo nincacointi jenemacanihqui.

Jascajahibaan bi ta Papan joi coin jascabi sca banetihqui, huetsajahama. Papan ta honantijaquin nescajaquin huishamanishqui: Jahuenahbo ta Hihbaan honanihqui hihqui. Noquen Hihbo hihbomahibaan ta hohchati jeneti jaiqui hihqui huetsa jahuen huisha rihbi.

Hapon xoboho ta horo quentiboya copi yami quentibo jatihiqui. Jascapa rahsima bi jihui xaxobo rihbi, mai quentibo rihbi jatihi. Caibo quenti ta hahqui pitibo naneti qui. Caibo rihbi ta hahqui huecaxbo naneti qui.
Jahuen rishta choquitai joni ta siriscaiqui, rishtajoma quenti quescapah, hahqui piti naneti quescapah can, siri. Xobo hihbo jaya teeti sca. Jayaxon siri teebo hahti sca jai.

Jascapahue: mai meha beronanbo hihqui quescari rishta shinanyahpabo jaiya jato tecayacahinhue. Pontehihti shinanhue. Noquen Hihbaan noque hahxonai honanrihbiquin. Joni huetsahon shinanrihbiquin. Jointi siripax jihuehue. Rishtajomaxon noquen Hihbo hihbomahibo betan tah min jascari jihueti jai.
Honanmabo hihresi yohuan yohuanax join bahchinanaibo betan hihyamahue. Jascapa yohuaman ta jonibo sinamahiqui. Min tah min honanai.
Rainyamaxonma bi tah min jatohon shinanxon Papan jonixon jatihibi jonibo yohitihi. Sirijaquin jato honanmaquin. Jato tenequin.
Mia nincacatsihyamahibo honahax bi yohuanxon pontejaquin yohihue. Huetsa shinan rah ta Papan jato hinantihiqui, jahuen joi nincoinahbo hihxon.
Tiroma yoshin queenai quescabijaquin jaabaan hahnon hihxon ta tiroma yoshiman jato hihbojanishqui. Jan jato bihni que bi ta Papan joi honanxon yoshin tenetihiqui.
